description: IT Minister inaugurates Telangana’s first rural AI Lab in Adavisrirampur village of Peddapalli district
body_lead: In a significant move towards ensuring equitable access to AI-powered tools, the first rural AI Lab, powered by T-Fiber, was inaugurated by Minister for IT and Industries D. Sridhar Babu at the Zilla Parishad High School in Adavisrirampur village of Peddapalli district on Thursday. According to official sources, the initiative is aimed at helping the rural students leverage AI-powered tools, thereby enhancing their learning outcomes. The IT Minister also inaugurated an Integrated Village CCTV surveillance system in the village on the occasion.
